statusNote: SHIPPED 2026-07-28 — Max RE-UAT PASSED, verbatim: "okay, passes". The re-UAT ran on the shipped 'hold apparent size (radius read)' toggle (Drivers folder), Jovian/Saturnian, jets ON, seed held, radius dragged across the track. R1's headline promise — drag radius, see the banding answer — is delivered. TWO OBSERVATIONS MAX RAISED AT THE SAME TIME, both recorded rather than folded into this contract because neither is an R1 defect: (1) HIS HYPOTHESIS FOR THE COMPOSITE GAP, verbatim: 'i do suspect that many of these legacy shader systems are not fully wired up into our proc gen model though, based on what you're saying about the band channel.' It has a concrete anchor already visible in the lab: the World Engine panel's own provenance line reads 'relief: LEGACY synth (carrier off)' whenever carrierOn is false (planet-lod-lab.html:4294, carrierOn = reliefBakeStrength > 0 AND riverOverlay.heightSource === 'carrier'). Routed to the R2 scope and to the 38-finding triage as a named question, NOT closed here. (2) PARKING-LOT ITEM, verbatim: 'rocky/earthlike planets tectonics seem to turn into noise after the planet radius gets beyond a certain size; not sure if that's intentional, especially given we created the tectonics system before implementing the new radius system.' ROOT CAUSE IDENTIFIED FROM SOURCE THE SAME SESSION (derived, not yet measured): bakeReliefCrossover(sVis) = 1 - smoothstep(0, BAKE_CROSS_SPAN=1.0, |log2 sVis|) deliberately crossfades the BAKED relief to zero as the disc departs sVis=1, handing the macro body to the analytic fbmd path. Since sVis = sqrt(R), |log2 sVis| = 0.5*|log2 R|, so the bake is HALF faded at R = 2 and COMPLETELY GONE at R >= 4 (and at R <= 0.25). On Rocky/Earthlike the baked cube is exactly where the plate-Voronoi tectonics lives (writePlateUpliftSphere — continents, plate boundaries, provinces); the fbmd path that replaces it is generic fBm. So above R ~= 4 the tectonic structure is by construction replaced with noise. This was a DISCLOSED tradeoff of the radius-display-scale increment, whose own source comment says 'RESIDUE (disclosed, D3): the baked continent PATTERN morphs into the analytic body across the fade — a visible change in continent CHARACTER, not size; the size-constancy bar is met.' What was never weighed is that character loss against the world engine's purpose, which is precisely that tectonics should express. Max's ordering note is the diagnosis: tectonics predates the radius system. FILED to the campaign tracker parking-lot; needs scoping, not an inline fix. (prior entry, the close-out that led to the pass) CLOSE-OUT 2026-07-28 — R1 IS RE-UAT-READY. Back to VERIFIED_PENDING_MAX, but on a RE-SPECIFIED AC-BANDS: no src/ or lab code changed since 6d120c4; what changed is that the AC had been closed on the WRONG QUANTITY and is now closed on the right one. THE DIAGNOSIS (evidence/G4-rendered-belt-count.md): the 2026-07-27 prime suspect — the e5-bands smoothstep 0.34/0.66 dead-zone — is KILLED by measurement. The RENDERED belt count DOES rise with radius: 4 -> 12 on Jovian across R = 2..16 RE, measured live at 7 radii by two independent counting methods that agree; fitted exponent +0.532 +/- 0.029 (n=7, dof=5, t95=2.571, r2=0.986) = PASS against the Rhines law's 0.5 AND distinguishable from the null 0. The real mechanism is an EXPONENT COLLISION: the Rhines band count goes as R^0.5 while the lab's display scale visScaleOf goes as R^0.5 (VIS_SCALE_EXP = 0.5, planet-lod-lab-core.js:45), so the disc grows on screen at exactly the rate the bands multiply and on-screen band DENSITY is invariant — fitted +0.031 +/- 0.029, i.e. consistent with ZERO. The roughness Max DID see rides uBandCount ~ R^1.0 through the F25 jet/shear/festoon terms and outruns the disc — fitted +0.361 +/- 0.040, significantly non-zero. Those two fits ARE the two halves of his sentence: 'increases the roughness of bands edges' (0.361) 'but does not increase the number of bands' (0.031, on screen). LAB-ONLY, AND THE GAME HAS NO STAKE (resolved at source, no browser needed): visScaleOf / VIS_SCALE_EXP have ZERO occurrences in src/; nothing in src/ consumes aBand / zonalBandCol / HEIGHT_GLSL; the game still bands planets from hard-coded literals in src/objects/Planet.js (sin(lat*3.5) :256, sin(lat*2.5)+sin(lat*5.0) :268, sin(lat*3.0)+sin(lat*6.0) :280) with no radius term whatsoever. So this UAT failure has ZERO shipped-game impact today — it is a lab-viewing artifact of the knob whose own source comment calls it 'the ONE UAT-tunable knob'. MAX'S DISPOSITION, ACCEPTED VERBATIM ('that seems fine to me'): do NOT retune VIS_SCALE_EXP; re-spec AC-BANDS to judge band count at PINNED ANGULAR SIZE (camera distance proportional to sVis — the discipline renderDeltaSweep already applies at planet-lod-lab.html:5370). Retuning the display scale to break the cancellation would trade one physical law's legibility against every other radius-scaled read in the lab, a far larger blast radius for a lab-only viewing convenience. AC-BANDS re-specified accordingly — audit trail in amendments[]. CLOSE-OUT RE-MEASUREMENT 2026-07-28 (working-Claude, in-page at HEAD, isolated context on :5175, page closed after, Max's own tab untouched): with the disc held at a constant apparent size (logical distance 3.0 at both radii, verified), Jovian / seed 1 / jets ON / spin frozen, the rendered band channel measured by an AMPLITUDE-INDEPENDENT spectral estimator gives 3.03 -> 6.01 cycles across the disc for R=4 -> R=16. A 4x radius change against a 1.983 ratio is R^0.494 — the Rhines exponent, independently reproduced by a method sharing nothing with the 7-point fit but the underlying field. Planted-defect control passed first (recovered 6 and 12 cycles exactly across a 5x amplitude spread). SHIPPED AS THE UAT AFFORDANCE, not a console paste (feedback_uat-keybind-design): a new 'hold apparent size (radius read)' checkbox sits with the radius slider in the Drivers folder, OFF by default, frame()-only, pure camera — it preserves the LOGICAL distance distance/sVis across a radius change, so wheel zoom stays fully live. Pure helper holdApparentDistance in planet-lod-lab-core.js, pinned by tests/hold-apparent-size.test.js incl. a planted no-op control. WITHDRAWN FROM THIS RECORD (was committed 0b9f133, corrected same session): a framebuffer-pixel claim of '11 -> 15 dark/light runs (+36%)'. It was a hand-rolled single-strip run count — amplitude-confounded (run counting is not a frequency measure; the low-contrast R=4 profile crosses its mean more often) and longitude-sensitive (the lab auto-spins; +/-2 runs per capture). Repeat captures of the SAME state gave 13 -> 14 and the 9-strip mean went the other way, 14.2 -> 12.7. The F31-haze hypothesis it supported is also dead: with clouds, haze and limb glow OFF the pixel spectrum is unchanged (5.85 -> 5.23 vs 5.92 -> 5.24). Max's correction, verbatim: 'didn't we put controls in place that can mathmatically read what's being rendered? You visually verifying stuff is usually inefficient' — a hand-rolled screenshot metric was written beside the purpose-built non-visual instrument this same workstream commissioned. Rule filed: feedback_use-the-built-instrument-not-a-hand-rolled-one. OPEN, STATED NOT RESOLVED: the same amplitude-independent estimator applied to screenshot PIXELS does not reproduce the doubling (peak 3 -> 4 cycles, centroid 5.9 -> 5.2) while the in-page band channel does (3.03 -> 6.01), and at R=4 the two agree exactly (3 cycles ~ 6 belts). Something between the band channel and the composited frame — lighting gradient, the F25 jet turbulence riding R^1.0, the 6-level Bayer posterize, or the perspective foreshortening the flat sin(lat) binning ignores — may not carry the full response at the high-R end. NO CLAIM IS MADE EITHER WAY and it is NOT a blocker on the re-UAT; it is the honest boundary of what the objective channel certifies, and it is named in AC-UAT so Max's eye is the judge of it rather than being told an answer. RE-UAT RECIPE (AC-UAT, Max's gate alone): open the lab on :5175, Drivers folder, tick 'hold apparent size (radius read)'; pick 'Gas giant (Jovian)' or 'Gas giant (Saturnian)' ONLY (the other three giants sit at the clamp floor of 3 across their whole drawn range and prove nothing); turn JETS ON; hold the seed; drag the 'planet radius (log)' slider across its track, pausing at each stop because the re-derive is on a 220 ms trailing debounce. WITHOUT THE TOGGLE THE EFFECT IS INVISIBLE BY CONSTRUCTION — that is the whole finding, not a workaround for a weak result. amendments.by: working-Claude, at the R1 close-out, on Max's accepted disposition
amendments.what: The AC as written closed on 'band count changes across the sweep', and was in fact closed on state.e5BandCount at a FIXED CAMERA. Re-specified onto the RENDERED belt count judged at PINNED ANGULAR SIZE (camera distance proportional to sVis).
amendments.why: TWO grounds. (1) WRONG QUANTITY: state.e5BandCount is a zero-crossing diagnostic of the realized u-profile. The e5-bands contract ALREADY ON RECORD says it does not correspond to visible belts (~14 readout vs ~5-6 visible on Jovian). Closing a visible-read AC on it is the conflation that let all 8 objective ACs measure green while Max's eye failed the build. (2) WRONG VIEWING CONDITION: measurement (evidence/G4-rendered-belt-count.md) shows the Rhines band count and the lab display scale BOTH go as R^0.5, so at a fixed camera the on-screen band density is invariant by construction — fitted +0.031 +/- 0.029, consistent with zero. Any AC judged at a fixed camera is therefore unfalsifiable for this quantity: it would read flat whether the physics were wired or not. Pinning the angular size is what makes the AC able to fail.
amendments.evidence: Rendered belts +0.532 +/- 0.029 vs the claimed 0.5 (n=7, dof=5, t95=2.571, r2=0.986) — lawVerdict PASS, and separable from the null 0 at resolving power 0.073. Independently reproduced at pinned apparent size by an amplitude-independent spectral estimator run in-page at HEAD: 3.03 -> 6.01 cycles across the disc for R=4 -> 16, ratio 1.983 over a 4x radius change = R^0.494, with its planted-defect control passing first. A framebuffer run-count corroboration was attempted, produced a false result, and is WITHDRAWN — see the statusNote and evidence/G4-rendered-belt-count.md.
amendments.notClaimed: That the exponent collision has been REMOVED. It has not — VIS_SCALE_EXP stays 0.5 by Max's accepted disposition. At a fixed camera the on-screen density will still read invariant; the AC and the UAT recipe now both state the viewing condition under which the response is visible.
amendments.generalRuleAdopted: MEASURE THE QUANTITY THE USER SEES, NOT THE NEAREST AVAILABLE NUMBER — and state the viewing condition under which it is visible, because a display transform can cancel a physical law exactly. Promoted to memory/feedback_measure-the-quantity-the-user-sees.md; generalises feedback_perceptual-read-gate-before-uat.
amendments.maxDecisionOwed: None outstanding — Max accepted the disposition verbatim ('that seems fine to me'). His open gate is the re-UAT itself.

amendments.by: working-Claude, during the build, after the 3-lens adversarial round
amendments.what: The AC as greenlit said BOTH threshold gates should flip with the drawn radius. Shipped behaviour splits them: cloud regime reads drawn, giant dynamo reads canonical.
amendments.why: Uniformly rewiring the dynamo gate was a defect, caught independently by all three lenses. TWO grounds, either sufficient. (1) STRUCTURAL: PRESET_ARCHETYPE deliberately maps 'Ice giant (Neptunian)' and 'Sub-Neptune (hazy)' to the same 'sub-neptune' key (V2-3 AC-TAXONOMY-NEPTUNE), and drawPresetRadius keys its PRNG on 'draw:radius:'+seed with NO preset name (driver-presets.js:271) — so the two draw BIT-IDENTICAL radii at every seed (measured 2001/2001). A size-keyed discriminator therefore cannot separate them at any seed, and separating them is the gate's entire recorded purpose. The rewire did not make the gate more responsive; it made it non-functional. (2) FRAME-DERIVED: the ratified V2-6 model is 'a bigger body of the SAME composition', so the drawn radius carries no composition information by construction; a composition classifier keyed on it is a category error. (3) CONSEQUENCE: because the Neptunian's derived magneticField is exactly 0.05 and the intensity guard is a strict '>', the rewire did not dim the ice giant's aurora but EXTINGUISHED it, on 67.5% of seeds including the shipped default — violating Max's own stated criterion 'nothing that worked before breaks'.
amendments.generalRuleAdopted: A CLASSIFIER reads the canonical radius; a PHYSICS INPUT reads the drawn radius. This is the same disposition AC-CRATERBOOT reached on evidence, now stated as the workstream's rule. Under it the three genuine physics inputs (:2863 Rhines band radius, :2947 storm drivers, :3306 jet stripe ladder) plus the cloud-regime gate read drawn; the dynamo gate and the crater-boot enable set read canonical, both allowlisted with recorded proof.
amendments.notClaimed: That dynamo strength is radius-independent — it is not. Expressing a size-responsive dynamo needs a discriminator reading composition/mass AND size, which is a physics edit. Recorded as an R2 item, NOT silently dropped.
amendments.maxDecisionOwed: Max may overrule: if he wants the dynamo to answer the slider, the honest route is the R2 composition-aware model, not re-pointing the size proxy. Surfaced in the UAT brief.

designDecisions: THE FRAME IS ALREADY RULED — NOT AN OPEN DESIGN CALL. The census listed 'physical km vs on-screen' as Max's call. It is not: two of his existing rulings compose to answer it. body-condition-vector.js:37 derives surfaceGravity = g_c*(R/R_c) from M proportional to rho*R^3 (V2-6 gravity coherence), so the slider means 'a bigger body of the same composition', mass ~R^3 and gravity ~R. His ratified display model is 'planet bigger, forms same size, that's it'. Composed: physics responds in the PHYSICAL km frame, the display keying holds on-screen form size constant. Visible signature of working radius = a change in feature COUNT and ARRANGEMENT, never in individual on-screen form size.

THE CONDITION VECTOR IS THE SINGLE SOURCE; THE FIX IS TO READ IT. Every frozen site reads _fp = DRIVER_PRESETS[preset] directly. The condition vector already carries the drawn radius and the coherent gravity, and the very same functions already pass state.planetRadiusEarth into deriveConditionVector one line away (planet-lod-lab.html:2851, :2930). So the fix is not 'thread the slider into five places' but 'stop bypassing the source that already has it'. This is a spine-conformance repair (driver connectivity, Rule 15), which is why AC-0 is not ceremonial here.

THE :5146 CRATER-BOOT SITE IS SETTLED BY MEASUREMENT, NOT BY A DESIGN CALL. Its source comment asserts 'Canonical radius suffices: the relevance predicate is a domain class, R-stable within a preset.' That is a testable claim about craterRelevanceOf, not a taste question. AC-CRATERBOOT sweeps radius across the full slider range for all presets and lets the evidence decide: never flips => stays canonical with a pinned test recording WHY; flips anywhere => it was a defect and gets the live feed. Either outcome is a PASS; an unmeasured assumption is not.

BYTE-IDENTITY AT CANONICAL RADIUS IS THE SAFETY MECHANISM, MIRRORING V2-6. Every golden / NAMED_BODY / headless path passes R === R_c, so R/R_c = 1.0 exactly in float64 and the rewire is bit-for-bit inert there. This is the same fence V2-6 used to land gravity coherence without re-capturing fixtures, and it is what makes a five-site rewire safe to do at once rather than in nervous slices.

uBandCount IS LIVE, CONTRARY TO THE 'RETIRED' NOTE. NOW.md records uBandCount as retired by the atmo increment, but planet-lod-height.glsl.js:1518/1530/1570 still read it and planet-lod-lab.html:5904 still feeds it from the frozen :3278. Either it reaches the render (and the frozen feed is visible) or those shader branches are dead (and the uniform should actually go). The build must establish which BEFORE rewiring :3278, because the answer changes whether AC-BANDS can even read a difference there.

RIVERS ARE A FRAME QUESTION, NOT A WIRING ONE. Their feed is already live (planet-lod-lab.html:3761 passes state.planetRadiusEarth). But widthRadiusFactor is proportional to refRadius/radiusEarth — an ON-SCREEN-CONSTANCY law, the opposite frame from craters' physical count ~R^2. Under the ruled frame that is arguably correct (it is display keying, expressed inside the river module instead of in the display layer), but it has never been measured. AC-RIVERS measures it and states which frame it is in; it does not silently 'fix' it to match craters.

At fixed preset, fixed seed and jets ON, sweeping radius produces a monotonic, measurable increase in the number of belts visible ON THE DISC — counted after the shader's own smoothstep(0.34,0.66) and polar-hood multiply, with the disc held at a constant on-screen size (camera distance proportional to sVis) — with a fitted exponent consistent with the Rhines law's sqrt(R). verifyVia.observable: Belt count rises monotonically across the sweep and fitPowerLaw returns an exponent consistent with 0.5 at the fit's OWN dof (Student-t, not z=2) and distinguishable from the null 0 — measured +0.532 +/- 0.029, n=7, dof=5, r2=0.986, lawVerdict PASS. Reported ALONGSIDE it, as the explanation of the UAT failure rather than as a second failure: bands-per-screen-height is consistent with ZERO under the same fit (+0.031 +/- 0.029) and roughness-per-screen-height is significantly non-zero (+0.361 +/- 0.040) — the two halves of Max's sentence. Confirmed independently at pinned apparent size by an AMPLITUDE-INDEPENDENT spectral estimator run in-page at HEAD: 3.03 -> 6.01 cycles across the disc for R=4 -> 16, ratio 1.983 over a 4x radius change = R^0.494. METHOD GUARD, earned twice by this workstream: (1) derivative-sign-change peak detection returns ZERO extrema on the saturated plateaus a band field produces and produced a false confirm of the dead-zone suspect on 2026-07-27; (2) run/zero-crossing counting is amplitude-confounded and produced a false framebuffer corroboration on 2026-07-28, now withdrawn. Any count used here must come from an amplitude-independent method with a planted-defect control, from the built instrument rather than a hand-rolled one, and two independent methods must agree. Evidence: evidence/G4-rendered-belt-count.md (incl. the withdrawn claim, kept as record) + evidence/G4-pinned/.

verifyVia.input: RE-UAT 2026-07-28, after the first UAT failed. Max loads the lab on :5175, opens the Drivers folder and ticks 'hold apparent size (radius read)' (the control sits directly under the radius readouts; no console, per feedback_uat-keybind-design). He then picks 'Gas giant (Jovian)' or 'Gas giant (Saturnian)', turns JETS ON, holds the seed, and drags the 'planet radius (log)' slider across its track, pausing at each stop for the 220 ms re-derive debounce. Wheel zoom stays live throughout — the toggle preserves whatever framing he wheels to. Then repeats on a rocky preset as the no-regression check.
verifyVia.observable: Max's holistic judgement. THE TOGGLE IS NOT OPTIONAL AND NOT A WORKAROUND: the Rhines band law and the lab display scale both go as R^0.5, so at a fixed camera the on-screen band density is invariant BY CONSTRUCTION (measured +0.031 +/- 0.029) — that is what he saw the first time, and it would have read identically whether the physics were wired or not. WHAT THE OBJECTIVE CHANNEL CERTIFIES, and where it stops: the rendered band channel doubles in frequency at pinned apparent size (3.03 -> 6.01 cycles, R^0.494). Whether the FULL doubling survives into the composited frame is NOT certified — a pixel-level estimator did not reproduce it at the high-R end, and the cause (lighting, the F25 jet turbulence riding R^1.0, the 6-level Bayer posterize, perspective foreshortening) is unadjudicated. That gap is precisely what his eye is being asked about; he is not being told the answer. Two known carve-outs so neither reads as failure: (1) individual form size is HELD CONSTANT on screen by design (his own ratified 'planet bigger, forms same size'), so what changes is how MANY bands there are and how they are arranged, not how big anything looks; (2) contrast also rises with radius, so part of the change may read as 'the bands got more legible' rather than purely 'there are more of them'. Volcanism and tectonics are still radius-blind here; that is R2, not a defect of this build.
